add_locations.name: jo9_meiki_sale
add_locations.body:
! JO9_MEIKI_SALE_V1: price selection only; local scratch variables do not persist.
result = 0
if $args[0] = 'eligible':
 if slave['virginity'] ! 4: exit
 if $interesting_specialisation[$npc_id] = 'concubine': result = 1
 if max(stat_importance['petting'], stat_importance['oral'], stat_importance['penetration'], stat_importance['orgy'], stat_importance['roleplay'], stat_importance['fetishism'], stat_importance['xenophily'], stat_importance['lesbiansex'], stat_importance['nipplefuck']) > 0: result = 1
 if max(demand['lesbiansex'], demand['nipplefuck'], demand['selftorture'], demand['golden_shower']) > 0: result = 1
 exit
end
if $args[0] = 'roll':
 local jo9_base = common_price[demand_rating[$npc_id]]
 local jo9_unit = jo9_base / 100
 local jo9_brand = 1 + (brand_reputation - 1) / 2
 local jo9_rating = (rating - demand_rating[$npc_id]) / 2
 local jo9_excess = 0
 if (demand_rating[$npc_id] + 1) / 2 = 1: jo9_excess = charm - 6
 if (demand_rating[$npc_id] + 1) / 2 = 2: jo9_excess = charm - 12
 if (demand_rating[$npc_id] + 1) / 2 = 3: jo9_excess = charm - 18
 if (demand_rating[$npc_id] + 1) / 2 = 4: jo9_excess = charm - 24
 if (demand_rating[$npc_id] + 1) / 2 = 5: jo9_excess = 2 * (charm - 38)
 local jo9_factor = 0
 if jo9_excess < 0:
  jo9_factor = 0
 elseif jo9_excess <= 7:
  jo9_factor = 1
 elseif jo9_excess < 15:
  jo9_factor = 2
 else
  jo9_factor = 3
 end
 local jo9_best = -2147483647
 local jo9_best_roll = 0
 local jo9_i = 0
 local jo9_roll = 0
 local jo9_charm_coefficient = 0
 local jo9_charm_bonus = 0
 local jo9_chance = 0
 local jo9_master_coefficient = 0
 local jo9_master_bonus = 0
 local jo9_price = 0
 ! Within each master coefficient interval the highest price is at its right endpoint.
 ! Keep the extra 65536 endpoint: QSP integer division reaches coefficient 9 there.
 for jo9_i = 0 to 4:
  jo9_roll = min(65536, 16384 * (jo9_i + 1) - 1)
  jo9_charm_coefficient = demand_rating[$npc_id] + jo9_roll / (65537 / (1 + demand_rating[$npc_id]))
  jo9_charm_bonus = jo9_unit * (jo9_excess / 2 + jo9_charm_coefficient + 2 * jo9_brand + 3 * jo9_rating)
  jo9_price = jo9_base
  if jo9_factor = 2: jo9_price += jo9_charm_bonus
  if jo9_factor = 3: jo9_price += jo9_charm_bonus + jo9_charm_bonus / 2
  jo9_chance = master_cha + master_domination + master_style + master_str + 4 * personal_relations[$npc_id] + jo9_roll / (65537 / 77)
  if custom_game = 0 and hero_choice = 4: jo9_chance += 2 * master_cha
  jo9_master_coefficient = 5 + jo9_roll / (65537 / 4)
  jo9_master_bonus = jo9_unit * (jo9_master_coefficient + jo9_rating) * (jo9_factor + jo9_brand) / 2
  if jo9_chance <= 30:
   jo9_master_bonus -= jo9_unit * jo9_rating
   jo9_price -= jo9_master_bonus
  elseif jo9_chance <= 49:
   jo9_price += 0
  elseif jo9_chance <= 68:
   jo9_price += jo9_master_bonus
  else
   jo9_price += jo9_master_bonus + jo9_master_bonus / 2
  end
  if jo9_price > jo9_best:
   jo9_best = jo9_price
   jo9_best_roll = jo9_roll
  end
 end
 result = jo9_best_roll
end
